review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines no new concept. The only definition-like item is a file-local notation `surjective`, which unfolds to `Function.Surjective f` on ring homomorphisms. Its job is to instantiate the meta-property predicates `StableUnderComposition`, `RespectsIso`, `IsStableUnderBaseChange`, `LocalizationPreserves` and `OfLocalizationSpan`. I grepped Mathlib for a competing global `RingHom` surjectivity property. The only hits were `RingHom.SurjectiveOnStalks`, which is a different, weaker concept, and `MorphismProperty.surjective` in `CategoryTheory/MorphismProperty/Concrete.lean`, which is categorical and serves a different purpose. All the theorems in this file are meta-property statements, so the rubric excludes them as standalone theorem duplication. The scoped notation is not a competing API. I found no justified finding.
